title: 第2768章 奥义源石与秩序天核第2767章 生死规则古关
content_zh:
“啊——！”
冲在最前面的多位修士被生命光束击中，瞬间衰老如枯木，精气尽失，头发花白，皮肤干裂如树皮，连喊叫声都变得沙哑无力。
另一些人被死亡光束扫过，身躯以肉眼可见的速度枯萎腐朽，如同被抽走了所有生机，化作干尸坠落。
惨叫声此起彼伏，半神与道法准神层次的修士成片倒下，如同割麦子一般，连反抗的余地都没有。
被光束波及的神灵也好不到哪里去，一个个肌体龟裂，神血洒落，不得不拼命催动神力防御。
有人拼死向前冲，却在中途被数十道光束同时击中，连惨叫都来不及发出便灰飞烟灭。
可想而知，是多么可怕。
六霸十二雄立时各展神通抵挡。
苍天霸王一拳轰出，紫色血气化作苍龙挡在身前，将大片光束震散，但那苍龙也在光束的冲击下不断崩碎重组。
小东皇东皇钟虚影浮现，金色音波席卷而出，将漫天光束震碎成漫天光雨，但每次震碎都需要消耗大量神力。
太元天神浑身神火暴涨，整个人如同烈日横空，光束还未靠近就被焚灭殆尽，但火焰也在不断被生死规则消磨。
元初小神王九道神环轮转，各种神道交替绞杀，将靠近的光束尽数磨灭，但每一次绞杀都让神环微微震颤。
北冥死神身形融入虚无，光束穿体而过却无法伤及分毫，但冥雾也被打散了不少。
秦玄踏前一步，周身生死神道骤然绽放，一轮巨大的生死太极图在他头顶浮现，缓缓旋转。
倾泻而来的生命光束与死亡光束，撞上生死太极图的刹那，竟被悄无声息地吞噬、磨灭、转化为精纯的生死道韵，融入太极图之中。
太极图非但没有被削弱，反而越转越快，越转越强，仿佛一处无底深渊，将所有攻击尽数吞没。
秦玄眸光如电，双手结印，太极图骤然放大，化作一方横贯天穹的轮回磨盘，朝着雄关碾压而去。
磨盘轮转之间，成千上万道生死光束如同泥牛入海，被尽数吞噬殆尽，连一丝涟漪都未曾激起……
六霸十二雄同时出手，各种神通术法同时爆发，将雄关上的守军轰得支离破碎。
紧随着六霸十二雄之后，其他试炼天骄以及界外修士各自施展神通，或打出滔天神光，或祭出本命神兵，密密麻麻的攻击如同暴雨般倾泻在城墙之上。

无数由生死规则凝聚而成的生灵炸开，化作漫天光雨消散。
雄关城墙也在众人的合力攻击之下层层崩塌，生死神纹崩碎瓦解，化作漫天的光雨洒落。
最终，轰隆一声巨响，整座雄关彻底崩塌，万千将士灰飞烟灭，只留下一片弥漫着生死道韵的废墟。
众人穿过雄关废墟，面前骤然开阔。
一座广袤的虚无之地展现在眼前，没有天穹，没有大地，只有无尽的虚空与飘浮的生死道纹。
content_en:
"Ah——!"
Many monks who rushed at the front were hit by the life beam. They instantly aged like dead trees, lost all their energy, their hair turned gray, their skin was as dry and cracked as tree bark, and even their shouts became hoarse and weak.
Others were swept by the death beam, and their bodies withered and decayed at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if all their vitality had been sucked away, and they turned into mummies and fell.
Screams came one after another, and the monks at the level of demigods and quasi-gods fell down in pieces, like wheat, leaving no room for resistance.
The gods affected by the beam were not much better. Their bodies were cracked and their divine blood was spilled. They had to desperately use their divine power to defend themselves.
Some people rushed forward desperately, but were hit by dozens of beams at the same time in the middle, and they were wiped out before they could even scream.
You can imagine how terrible it is.
The six tyrants and twelve heroes immediately used their magical powers to resist.
The Cangtian Overlord punched out, and the purple blood energy turned into a Canglong to block in front of him, scattering a large beam of light, but the Canglong also continued to break and reorganize under the impact of the beam.
The phantom of Xiaodonghuangdonghuangzhong appeared, and golden sound waves swept out, shattering the sky's beam of light into a sky full of light rain, but each shattering required a lot of divine power.
The Divine Fire of Taiyuan God surged all over his body, and his whole body was like the scorching sun across the sky. The beam of light was burned out before it even got close, but the flames were also constantly being consumed by the rules of life and death.
At the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, the nine divine rings of the little god king rotated, and various divine ways strangled alternately, destroying all the approaching beams, but each strangulation made the divine ring tremble slightly.
The body of the Beiming Death God merged into the void, and the beam of light passed through the body but could not hurt it at all, but the fog of the underworld was also dispersed a lot.
Qin Xuan took a step forward, and the divine way of life and death suddenly bloomed around him, and a huge Tai Chi diagram of life and death appeared above his head, spinning slowly.
The pouring beams of life and death beams collided with the Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death, and were silently swallowed, obliterated, and transformed into the pure Taoist rhyme of life and death, which was integrated into the Tai Chi Diagram.
Instead of being weakened, Tai Chi Tu turned faster and faster, becoming stronger and stronger, like a bottomless abyss, swallowing up all attacks.
Qin Xuan's eyes were as bright as lightning, and he formed seals with his hands. The Tai Chi Diagram suddenly enlarged and turned into a wheel of reincarnation across the sky, crushing towards Xiongguan.
As the millstone rotates, thousands of beams of life and death are like mud cows entering the sea, and are swallowed up without even a ripple...
The six tyrants and twelve heroes took action at the same time, and various magical powers and spells broke out at the same time, blasting the defenders at the gate to pieces.
Following the Six Hegemons and Twelve Heroes, the other trial geniuses and outsider cultivators each used their magical powers, either firing out the overwhelming divine light, or sacrificing their own divine weapons, and dense attacks poured down on the city wall like a torrential rain.
Countless creatures condensed by the rules of life and death exploded and dissipated into a rain of light across the sky.
The Xiongguan city wall also collapsed layer by layer under the combined attack of everyone, and the divine patterns of life and death shattered and disintegrated, turning into a rain of light that filled the sky.
In the end, there was a loud bang, and the entire pass collapsed completely, thousands of soldiers were wiped out, leaving only a ruin filled with the charm of life and death.
Everyone passed through the ruins of Xiongguan, and their eyes suddenly opened up.
A vast land of nothingness unfolds in front of you. There is no sky, no earth, only endless void and floating patterns of life and death.
